status_at_freeze: Portable packaging amendment: original first/first-v2 outcomes already known; source and fixture bytes remain unchanged.
purpose: Check equality-based linked summaries on authored synthetic records; separate from the original 92,000-cell execution study.
inputs: Only the selected customer identifier and withdrawal amount plus a synthetic row identifier. No original records, institutional ledger, or participant judgments are copied.
execution: Compile only packaged pseudonymize_data FunctionDef AST, with executable identity to originals checked locally before packaging. No module initialization, main, SQL, database, or file-output code.
positive: Unchanged row identifiers, amounts, and source frames
All input/output customer equality pairs agree
Customer withdrawal counts and sums preserved
independent_reference: Raw row-pair identities and raw customer counts/amount sums. No expected SHA-256 outputs are computed.
negative_control: In a copy of the HF output, replace its first customer's first pseudonym with the second existing customer's pseudonym. Both source customers have three CD rows, so the join count remains 144; exact row-pair identity and grouped summaries must detect the wrong link.
repeat: Run the identical finite suite twice. Results exclude timestamps and must be byte-identical.
scope: Finite output-utility property check of two selected functions, not model inference, human validation, a new institution, measured analytic benefit, privacy certification, or verification of masked/generalized join keys.

packaging_amendment.changes: Package-relative dependencies only; operational journal omitted; selected functions, synthetic inputs, metrics and negative control unchanged. AST digests use a version-independent canonical representation; original recorded AST hashes remain separately retained.
